subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should stranded `message_tool_only` finals recover only behind the new `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` opt-in flag, recover by default through the successor approach, or remain diagnostics-only?
rationale: Current docs define no message-tool call as private/no source reply, while this PR adds a config surface and replays private final text into a bounded retry; automation cannot choose that privacy and product policy.

options.title: Keep opt-in recovery after proof
options.body: Approve this default-off recovery shape only after redacted real external chat proof demonstrates one bounded retry and no private metadata leakage.

options.title: Prefer default recovery
options.body: Use a refreshed successor approach if maintainers want existing `message_tool_only` users protected without adding a new config flag.

options.title: Stay diagnostics-only
options.body: Reject runtime recovery and keep warning/docs behavior if preserving the strict privacy contract matters more than automatic recovery.

recommendation.title: Keep opt-in recovery after proof
recommendation.body: Approve this default-off recovery shape only after redacted real external chat proof demonstrates one bounded retry and no private metadata leakage.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the diagnostics-only policy step for this issue class and is the strongest history signal for the product/privacy decision.
